crossRefs.note: Then Moses said to Aaron, “This is what Yahweh spoke of, saying, ‘I will show myself holy to those who come near me…
They gathered their brothers, sanctified themselves, and went in, according to the commandment of the king by Yahweh’s…
But the priests were too few, so that they could not skin all the burnt offerings. Therefore their brothers the Levites…
Gather the people. Sanctify the assembly. Assemble the elders. Gather the children, and those who nurse from breasts.…
Let the priests, the ministers of Yahweh, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, “Spare your people…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of Yahweh, the God of Israel.
translations.bsb: So the priests and Levites consecrated themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.
translations.kjv: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.
translations.asv: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of Jehovah, the God of Israel.
